note: Re-measured 2026-10-16 and nothing needed correcting -- the third case in this review whose record held in full, after 03 and 10. Probe site 51 marks the pointer the loop condition reads before the step that may release its page, the release of the leaf in fts5SegIterNextPage, and the pointer again on the way out, where it judges it by address. The three lines fall in order on every platform: STEP pData=X, RELEASE leaf p=B, then a witness kind=UAF with blk=B and ca=X, so the pointer is inside the leaf the step had just released. The offset into that leaf differs by platform because the page layout does: 39 bytes of a 64-byte block natively, 55 of 128 on virtual Capstone, 55 of 78 on CheriBSD, where the witness also prints tag=1 cb=<arena>+262144 and so measures why that arm stays silent. hits=7 witnesses=1 on all three, which reproduces the 2026-10-06 reading exactly. The case's own reachability contract -- the instance vocab must yield 6 rows, where 'row' and 'col' yield 4 and never enter the buggy function -- held in every run
